en_title: Remedy Boss Reacts After Control Resonant Sells 1 Million Copies, Becoming Studio's Fastest-Selling Game
subtitle: 「开局强劲」
opus_summary: 《控制：共振》三周售出100万份，超越用时两个月达成这一销量的《心灵杀手2》，成为Remedy销售速度最快的游戏。工作室发文感谢玩家支持，实体版也已推出。

paragraphs.en: Control Resonant has sold one million copies, becoming Remedy’s fastest-selling game in spite of leakers cracking the title and pirating it after its digital launch in September.
paragraphs.cn: 《控制：共振》销量已达100万份，成为Remedy销售速度最快的游戏。尽管该作9月以数字版发售后，泄露者便将其破解并传播盗版，但仍取得了这一成绩。

paragraphs.en: Remedy celebrated this milestone on October 15, writing on Twitter/X, “Thank you for the support. For playing, sharing, and being a part of the community.”
paragraphs.cn: Remedy于10月15日在X上发文庆祝这一里程碑：「感谢大家的支持。感谢大家游玩、分享，并成为社区的一员。」

paragraphs.en: Remedy’s communications director Thomas Puha also commented on this achievement, saying, “There we go. Strong start.”
paragraphs.cn: Remedy传播总监Thomas Puha也对此表示：「做到了。开局强劲。」

paragraphs.en: This means that Control Resonant has soared past Alan Wake 2 , which previously held the record for the studio’s fastest-selling title. The legacy sequel reached one million copies sold two months after its release; Control Resonant has achieved that figure in just three weeks.
paragraphs.cn: 《控制：共振》的销售速度由此大幅超越《心灵杀手2》，后者此前保持着Remedy游戏销售速度最快的纪录。《心灵杀手2》这部经典续作用了两个月才达到100万份销量，而《控制：共振》仅用三周就达成了这一成绩。

paragraphs.en: This is welcome news for both Remedy and fans of the game, many of whom urged players against downloading the pirated version of the title when it launched digitally in late September. It seems this wasn’t a crippling setback for the developer, though, given its current financial success — and physical editions of the game have just now been released, so there’s still more profit to be had.
paragraphs.cn: 这对Remedy和游戏粉丝而言都是好消息。该作9月下旬以数字版发售时，许多粉丝曾呼吁玩家不要下载盗版。不过，从目前的商业成绩来看，盗版似乎并未给开发商造成致命打击。而游戏实体版也刚刚推出，还有更多利润可期。

paragraphs.en: Control Resonant was met with critical acclaim among both reviewers and players alike. We at IGN scored it an eight out of 10 , with reviewer Michael Higham saying, “Even when combat's sharp edge eventually dulls, Control Resonant is a great addition to the Remedyverse. While its story follows a more standard framework, its gravitational pull is in the inventive world built around it and the humanization that grounds the paranatural intrigue.”
paragraphs.cn: 《控制：共振》获得了评测者与玩家的一致好评。IGN为其打出8分，满分10分。评测者Michael Higham写道：「即便战斗最终不再那么精彩，《控制：共振》依然为Remedy宇宙增添了一部佳作。虽然故事采用了较为常规的框架，但围绕它构建的世界充满创意，对人物的刻画也让超自然谜团有了真实可感的根基，这些才是它的吸引力所在。」

paragraphs.en: In fact, the game was so good that many internet pirates decided against illegally downloading it, choosing instead to support Remedy in the hopes that its success would help keep the studio alive.
paragraphs.cn: 事实上，这款游戏出色到让不少盗版用户放弃了非法下载，转而选择支持Remedy，希望游戏的成功能帮助工作室继续生存下去。

paragraphs.en: "One of the very few games I'm going to be buying, Remedy are on the brink of bankruptcy, this is their make or break title, I love their games and gotta do what I can to keep them afloat," wrote one fan on a piracy subreddit.
paragraphs.cn: 一位粉丝在Reddit的盗版讨论版块写道：「这是少数几款我打算掏钱买的游戏之一。Remedy正濒临破产，这款游戏决定着他们的成败。我喜欢他们的游戏，得尽我所能帮他们撑下去。」

paragraphs.en: "I wasn't planning to buy it but now I feel like I should," another said. "I like Remedy. They do good games."
paragraphs.cn: 另一位用户说：「我本来没打算买，但现在觉得应该买一份。我喜欢Remedy。他们做的游戏很好。」

paragraphs.en: Remedy is known for titles like the original Control game, Alan Wake 2, Max Payne , and Quantum Break . And while their offerings have been met with high praise from players, they aren’t necessarily tailored for mass appeal, leaving some gamers worried about the developer’s future — but if these latest figures are anything to go by, it seems to be faring just fine.
paragraphs.cn: Remedy以初代《控制》、《心灵杀手2》、《马克思·佩恩》和《量子破碎》等作品闻名。虽然这些作品深受玩家好评，却未必以迎合大众口味为目标，因此一些玩家担心这家开发商的未来。不过，从最新销量来看，Remedy的状况似乎还不错。
